gen-zen-dots-gf-istok-web: Zen Dots gives every letter generous space around it, a friendly techy display face. Istok Web follows in a plain sans with rounded letters and a clearly open side; a large heading size lets Zen Dots show off.
gen-zen-dots-gf-jost: Jost draws every curve as thick as its straight stems, a clean and professional body face. Jost against the wide-spaced, low-contrast Zen Dots gives the pair one clear strength: both stay open and legible.
gen-zen-dots-gf-jura: Jura reads neutral and clean, its strokes as constant as bent wire and its s curves opening wide at both ends. Zen Dots above it keeps that same openness.
gen-zen-dots-gf-k2d: K2D keeps a tube-like thickness through every bend, with terminals hanging far from the bowl. Zen Dots earns its keep big and short, where its roomy techy shapes get space to be noticed.
gen-zen-dots-gf-kanchenjunga: Kanchenjunga holds its lines like a technical drafting pen. Zen Dots is best at friendly, spacious display moments, while Kanchenjunga, a contemporary sans-serif, is best at staying crisp even at low resolution.
gen-zen-dots-gf-kantumruy-pro: Kantumruy Pro has an e that opens clearly to the right, with no hairlines and no swells. Zen Dots earns its keep big and short, where its techy, friendly shapes have room to stand out.
gen-zen-dots-gf-kodchasan: Zen Dots leaves generous room around every letter, and that openness holds at every weight. Kodchasan, a sans-serif with hanging terminals and no calligraphic thinning, would read smoothly and unhurried over a long passage.
gen-zen-dots-gf-koho: Friendly is the first word for Zen Dots, a display face with generous room around every letter shape. And KoHo, a clean sans-serif with wide c apertures, would read smoothly and comfortably across a long passage.
gen-zen-dots-gf-kosugi: Techy but welcoming, Zen Dots spreads out with generous openings at every weight. And Kosugi, a sans-serif with an open-jawed c like a pair of pliers, matches that openness with its wire-bent look.
gen-zen-dots-gf-kosugi-maru: Friendly and techy, Zen Dots leaves generous room around every letter shape. And Kosugi Maru, a contemporary sans with neon-tube strokes of one steady thickness, carries that same open feeling into the text beneath.
